scripts.android:apk: pnpm sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) ./gradlew assembleDebug -q
scripts.release:android: pnpm sync && cd android && JAVA_HOME=$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 21) ./gradlew --no-daemon -q bundleRelease && echo android/app/build/outputs/bundle/release/app-release.aab
scripts.release:ios: pnpm sync && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -destination generic/platform=iOS -archivePath build/Downhill.xcarchive -allowProvisioningUpdates -quiet archive && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath build/Downhill.xcarchive -exportOptionsPlist ExportOptions.plist -exportPath build/export -allowProvisioningUpdates -quiet && echo ios/App/build/export/App.ipa
